seasonalityNotes: October to December brings dry, cool air and the clearest skies of the northern year; June to August is hot and humid with heavy afternoon rain.
gettingAround: Noi Bai (HAN) sits about 27 km north of the centre; the airport bus, taxis and Grab typically reach the Old Quarter in 40–60 minutes.

promotion.title: LotuStudents — up to 20% off Economy Lite
promotion.summary: Verified students aged 15–31 travelling from Australia to Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City can receive up to 20% off Economy Lite fares. Single-segment itineraries only; registration, document verification and blackout periods apply.
